topic: Explain what's going on with the Hormuz strait
hook: Explain what's going on with the Hormuz strait
script:
Timed VO · youtube · one_time_short_episode · centered_independent · nonfiction · global_overview

ACT 1
STUDIO — COLD OPEN
00:00:02–00:01:32
WIDE
ACTION: Host at a map table. Gulf chart on the wall. No invented family.

STUDIO — GULF MAP
00:01:34–00:03:04
WIDE
ACTION: Host at a Gulf map. A dated chyron waits. No family in the shot.

00:03:04–00:05:34
MCU
NARRATOR
In 2018 the United States withdrew from the JCPOA, tightening the Iran file around the Gulf. I'm staying on that withdrawal and that tighter file. [jcpoa-2018]

ARCHIVE — 2018 ANNOUNCEMENT
00:05:36–00:07:06
CUTAWAY
ACTION: Host at a Gulf map. A dated chyron waits. No family in the shot.

00:07:06–00:09:36
MCU
NARRATOR
Who drives that repeated line is not on our list. I am leaving the hole visible. [jcpoa-2018]

00:09:36–00:10:21
TWO-SHOT
INTERVIEW: Ask for the public date only. Do not let a later scare rewrite 2018.

B-ROLL — STRAIT OF HORMUZ
ACT 2
00:10:23–00:11:53
WIDE
ACTION: Tanker in an open Hormuz lane, land close on both sides. The water is quiet.

00:11:53–00:14:23
MCU
NARRATOR
A large share of seaborne oil still transits the Strait of Hormuz. Tankers still use that lane. OPEC published that share. [hormuz-share]

ENERGY DESK
00:14:25–00:15:55
CUTAWAY
ACTION: Tanker in an open Hormuz lane, land close on both sides. The water is quiet.

00:15:55–00:18:25
MCU
NARRATOR
Who drives that repeated line is not on our list. I am leaving the hole visible. [hormuz-share]

00:18:25–00:19:10
TWO-SHOT
INTERVIEW: Ask who is putting that share out. The named issuer on the row is OPEC.

NEWSROOM — OVERNIGHT
00:19:12–00:20:42
WIDE
ACTION: Overnight newsroom. Oil ticker running. A scare is not a measurement on screen.

00:20:42–00:23:12
MCU
NARRATOR
You'll hear that any Hormuz scare means oil crashes the world overnight. That's the scare. I'm not proving a crash from this beat. [oil-panic]

STUDIO — SCARE LINE
00:23:14–00:24:44
CUTAWAY
ACTION: Overnight newsroom. Oil ticker running. A scare is not a measurement on screen.

00:24:44–00:27:14
MCU
NARRATOR
Who drives that repeated line is not on our list. I am leaving the hole visible. [oil-panic]

00:27:14–00:27:59
TWO-SHOT
INTERVIEW: Ask what we can cite on this beat. Do not invent the next event.

PRODUCER DESK
ACT 3
00:28:01–00:29:31
WIDE
ACTION: Producer-state energy desk. Hormuz marked open on a shipping board.

00:29:31–00:32:01
MCU
NARRATOR
Producer states treat an open Hormuz as an oil-market given. That's the industry frame. [producer-frame]

SHIPPING BOARD
00:32:03–00:33:33
CUTAWAY
ACTION: Producer-state energy desk. Hormuz marked open on a shipping board.

00:33:33–00:36:03
MCU
NARRATOR
That is the sentence we have. I am not stacking a later scare on it. [producer-frame]

00:36:03–00:36:48
TWO-SHOT
INTERVIEW: Ask what we can cite on this beat. Do not invent the next event.

NIGHT WATER — HORMUZ
00:36:50–00:38:20
WIDE
ACTION: Night water in the strait. Empty lane. No mines on camera.

00:38:20–00:40:50
MCU
NARRATOR
There's a claim that Hormuz has already been mined shut under a hidden navy treaty. I can't run that as fact. You still hear the claim. You don't get a minefield from me. [secret-closure]

STUDIO — UNSOURCED CLAIM
00:40:52–00:42:22
CUTAWAY
ACTION: Night water in the strait. Empty lane. No mines on camera.

00:42:22–00:44:52
MCU
NARRATOR
There's a claim that Hormuz has already been mined shut under a hidden navy treaty. I can't run that as fact. You still hear the claim. You don't get a minefield from me. [secret-closure]

00:44:52–00:45:37
TWO-SHOT
INTERVIEW: Ask for a source on this claim. If none lands, it stays a claim.

STUDIO — THE HOLE
00:45:39–00:47:09
INSERT
ACTION: Two dated cards on a table. No arrow drawn.

00:47:09–00:50:09
MCU
NARRATOR
I cannot tell you that the 2018 JCPOA exit caused the 2023-2024 Hormuz panic. That connection is not sourced. [jcpoa-2018] [oil-panic]
